|printed_game_text=<span lang="ja">3フォース消費して、場の敵の側に配備する。操縦ドロイド／ナビコン・アイコンのついた宇宙戦闘機はすべて配備コスト＋1となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Astromech-Shortage-PSA-164793252.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ハイパースペースへの逃亡をふせぐために、宇宙戦闘機の操縦ドロイドを狙い撃ちするのは、帝国軍パイロットの常套手段だ。無傷の操縦ドロイドが不足すれば、宇宙戦闘機の迅速な配備も困難になる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Astromech shortage.

'''Card text:'''
Use 3 Force to deploy on the opponent's side of the table. All starfighters with an astromech or nav computer icon are deploy +1.

'''Lore:'''
Imperial pilots routinely pick off starfighter astromechs to stop hyperspace escapes. If undamaged astromechs run short, rapid starfighter deployment becomes hard.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese applies deploy +1 to starfighters with those icons; the English names opponent's starships.
|notes=Japanese-language printing of [[Astromech Shortage]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101.
